name: TanStack Router (SPA)
description: Vite + TanStack Router. Client-side single-page app, no server.

tokens.STACK_SUMMARY:
- This project is a single-page application (SPA) built with TypeScript, React,
  and Mantine.
- Routing is handled by **TanStack Router** (`@tanstack/react-router`). We do
  **not** use TanStack Start. There is no server-side rendering, no server
  functions, and no server entry point. Everything runs client-side.
tokens.STACK_DESCRIPTION:
A client-side single-page application (SPA) built with Vite, React, Mantine,
and TanStack Router. There is no server-side rendering and no server entry
point: everything runs in the browser. We do **not** use TailwindCSS.
tokens.ROUTING_NOTES:
Routes are file-based. Add a file under `src/routes/` and the TanStack Router
Vite plugin regenerates `src/routeTree.gen.ts` automatically. Never edit
`routeTree.gen.ts` (or any `*.gen.*` file) by hand.
